product.title: Snake River Scenic Float

description.text: If you think floating down the Snake is only for the outdoorsy, think again. With this tour, you'll ride a raft with high-back seats, making this ultra-scenic journey great for young and old. Stops include Grand Teton National Park, Moose Wilson Rd. A stable ride across a gentle current lets you relax in the open air, catching some of Jackson Hole's best views—and possibly even eagles, elk, moose, bears, and more.Float on the Snake River, with comfortable seats a priority Get away from the crowds and deep into the backcountry, where wildlife congregate Great for most ages—no rafting experience required Limited to 12 travelers, you'll get a fun, small Ideal for travelers basing in Jackson Hole who want a guided Wyoming outing without self-driving mountain roads.
